cd /home/zhouhuijuan1987/wiki/youtube-video-research-wiki
set -a && source ~/.agent-brain-plugins.env 2>/dev/null; set +a
python3 /home/zhouhuijuan1987/agent-brain-plugins/youtube-wiki/scripts/sop_stage_guard.py \
  --stage b \
  --pipeline-id "pipe-90fa385" \
  --max-minutes 20 \
  --wiki-path "/home/zhouhuijuan1987/wiki/youtube-video-research-wiki" \
  --tg-token-env "YOUTUBE_WIKI_TG_TOKEN" \
  --tg-chat-id "6938920500"

cd /home/zhouhuijuan1987/wiki/youtube-video-research-wiki

LINK_FILES_RAW=$(git -c core.quotepath=false ls-files -- 'raw/youtube-links/')

URLS=$(echo "$LINK_FILES_RAW" | while IFS= read -r f; do
  CLEAN_F=$(echo "$f" | sed -e 's/^"//' -e 's/"$//')
  if [ -f "$CLEAN_F" ]; then
    grep -oP 'https?://(www\.)?(youtube\.com/watch\?v=|youtu\.be/)[\w\-?=&]+' "$CLEAN_F"
  fi
done | sort | uniq)

python3 /home/zhouhuijuan1987/agent-brain-plugins/youtube-wiki/skills/sop-notebooklm-research/scripts/notebooklm_processor.py $URLS > /tmp/processor_full_output.txt 2>&1
